title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataTransfer
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataTransfer. Defines the basic structure for data transfers, including reasons and scope. Base class with concrete subclasses SubProcessorDataTransfer and ThirdCountryDataTransfer in the Gaia-X ontology, each modeled as its own entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataTransfer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

reason.description: Property. Reason for which the transfer might occur.

scope.description: Property. Perimeter of data that will be transferred.
